title: Claim Source Trail
user: Undergraduate humanities and social-science students learning digital research workflows who need to practice attaching a claim to an exact source location and a reason it supports the claim.
smallest_useful_product: Privacy-first web app with a four-field claim card, DOI/URL/author citation metadata, page/section locator, counterevidence flag, and export to Markdown/CSV.
success_measure: In one classroom pilot, 75% of submitted claims include a verifiable locator and instructor spot checks find fewer than 10% unsupported claim-source links.
constraints: Store citations and learner notes only with clear deletion; respect publisher access/copyright; avoid claims of truth verification; WCAG-friendly keyboard workflow.
